Clock: Dusk Cue.script: (function(){const tk=check({type:'game-tick'})||0;if([storage.sleepTick,storage.skipTick].includes(tk)){skip=true;return;}const NT=String(check({type:'story-text'})||'').split('\n').filter(l=>!/^\s*(?!narrator:)[a-z][\w .'-]{0,40}:\s/i.test(l)).map(l=>l.replace(/^\s*narrator:\s*(<[^>]*>\s*)*/i,'')).join('\n').toLowerCase().replace(/["\u201c][^"\u201d]{0,600}["\u201d]/g,' ');const X=/\b(tomorrow|will|until|till|if|last|yesterday|earlier|before|plan\w*|remember\w*|would|could|should|might)\b|'ll\b/;const D=NT.split(/[.!?]+/).some(s=>/\b(evening (light|street|streets|crowd|air|sky|rush)|dusk|sunset|the sun (drops|sets|goes down|is going down)|(sky|air|street|streets|campus|windows?) (is )?darkening|darkening (sky|street|streets|road|forest|campus|windows?)|(floodlights|streetlights|lamps|lights) ((have|has|had) )?(come|came|click|clicked|flicker|flickered) on|the light is going|night (falls|is falling))\b/.test(s)&&!X.test(s));if(!D){skip=true;return;}storage.currentBandIndex=6;storage.cueTick=tk;effects.push({type:'write-number',key:'currentBandIndex',operator:'set',value:6});})();
